title: Slurpees
description: This mod adds Cherry, Blue Raspberry, Coca Cola, Zero Sugar, and every possible combination!
body:
This mod adds Slurpees. To get a Slurpee, you'll need a Slurpee Machine.

Recipe: 7 iron in a leggings shape, a lever in the middle, glass pane in the bottom middle.

Right click it and you'll see a GUI. This is where you'll make the Slurpees. Everything goes in its labeled slot.

Cup recipe: 7 paper in a cauldron shape.

Straw recipe: 3 paper going down, 1 paper on top to the right.

Ice recipe: okay just kidding there is no crafting recipe for ice in the mod

Flavoring recipe: Water bottle, chemicals, sugar, dye.

Use white dye for zero sugar, brown for Coca-Cola, light blue for blue raspberry, and red for cherry.

Chemicals recipe: Rotten flesh (yes i know this is weird, but it's the only recipe I could think of)

You can craft different Slurpees together to get combinations. All combinations will work as long as you don't repeat a Slurpee (no crafting cherry and blue raspberry slurpee with cherry).
